analysis:
Examined the shape-warmup addition (EngineV2Bridge+ShapeWarmup.swift), the IdleCalibrationCoordinator session/cancel bookkeeping, the GlobalKVCacheBudget.proactiveReclaimSweep gate, and the ModelCalibrationPolicy cells and state. No concrete security regression was identified.

The warmup runs synthetic prompts from modelCalibrationPrompt(), which is existing code. These are locally generated, so no consumer plaintext (A-001) enters them. The cells are marked warmup and sampled, so no rate or counter moves. The warmup logger records only the model ID, cell counts, timings and probe durations, with no prompt content. It runs before provider registration at startup, so no remote party can trigger it. Foreground preemption is unchanged: beginForeground still cancels the session and awaits its retirement.

proactiveReclaimSweep now skips scheduling when a session exists. This briefly defers cache trimming (T-028, residual GPU memory) and could add small memory pressure while a session lasts. The session is bounded by shapeWarmupBudgetSeconds (20s), and the budget guard is also bounded, so the availability impact is minor and not a finding. Reclaim triggered by reservation refusal (recordReservationRefusal -> scheduleReclaim) is not gated, so admission self-heal is preserved.

Warmup is a new TTFT-relevant behavior only at startup. The shaderCache probe timing is local and not exposed to consumers. The DARKBLOOM_TTFT_SHAPE_WARMUP environment variable is local operator-controlled and can only disable or force the warmup, which is within the operator's existing control (TB-003).

Remaining unverified: the callers (ProviderLoop and StandaloneServer) that invoke runShapeWarmupBeforeServing and startShapeWarmupIfNeeded, and the implementations of runModelCalibrationCell and modelCalibrationPrompt, were not supplied. I did not confirm that warmup cells bypass the prefix-cache donation (T-041) path and so do not write synthetic prefixes to the SSD cache. That is benign for confidentiality, but the wear and TTL effects were not checked.
